        "lateral_extent",
        "lateral_taper",
        "vertical_extent",
        "vertical_taper",
    )
    
    
    def read(path):
        return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
    
    
    def write(path, value):
        Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    
    
    def sha(path):
        return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    
    
    def sources():
        historical = read(SOURCE_PLAN)["hashes"]
        selected = dict(historical)
        selected[str(BASELINE)] = sha(BASELINE)
        selected[str(Path(__file__))] = sha(__file__)
        selected[str(HERE / "audit.py")] = sha(HERE / "audit.py")
        for name in ("diagnostics.py", "schema.json", "plan.json"):
            path = HERE.parent / "coordinate-v1" / name
            if path.exists():
                selected[str(path)] = sha(path)
        return selected
    
    
    def verify(plan):
        for path, expected in plan["hashes"].items():
            if sha(path) != expected:
                raise ValueError("Fingerprint changed: " + path)
        validate_plan(plan)
    
    
    def load_core():
        sys.path.insert(0, str(CHECKOUT))
        from lsy_drone_racing.control import mpcc_broad_core
    
        if Path(mpcc_broad_core.__file__).resolve() != (
            CHECKOUT / "lsy_drone_racing/control/mpcc_broad_core.py"
        ):
            raise ValueError("Unexpected controller import origin")
        return mpcc_broad_core
    
    
    def validate_case(settings):
        import math
    
        baseline = read(BASELINE)["fastest"]
        if set(settings) != set(baseline):
            raise ValueError("Complete setting sections required")
        if set(settings["mpcc"]) != set(baseline["mpcc"]):
            raise ValueError("Complete known mpcc settings required")
        if settings["mpcc_experiment"] != baseline["mpcc_experiment"]:
            raise ValueError("Geometry policy settings are frozen")
        changed = [k for k, v in baseline["mpcc"].items() if settings["mpcc"][k] != v]
        if len(changed) > 1 or any(k not in PARAMETERS for k in changed):
            raise ValueError("Only one departure setting may vary")
        for k in PARAMETERS:
            value = settings["mpcc"][k]
            low, high = round(baseline["mpcc"][k] * 0.8, 12), round(baseline["mpcc"][k] * 1.2, 12)
            if isinstance(value, bool) or not math.isfinite(value) or not low <= value <= high:
                raise ValueError("Outside frozen supported preparation range: " + k)
        for prefix in ("influence", "lateral", "vertical"):
            if settings["mpcc"][prefix + "_taper"] > settings["mpcc"][prefix + "_extent"]:
                raise ValueError("Taper cannot exceed extent")
        values, geometry = load_core().validated_settings(settings["mpcc"], settings["mpcc_experiment"])
        if values != settings["mpcc"] or geometry != settings["mpcc_experiment"]:
            raise ValueError("Core changed effective settings")
    
    
    def build_plan():
        baseline = read(BASELINE)
        cases = {"baseline": copy.deepcopy(baseline["fastest"])}
        for parameter in PARAMETERS:
            for label, scale in [("lower", 0.8), ("higher", 1.2)]:
                setting = copy.deepcopy(baseline["fastest"])
                setting["mpcc"][parameter] = round(setting["mpcc"][parameter] * scale, 12)
                if setting not in cases.values():
                    cases[parameter + "_" + label] = setting
        plan = {
            "schema_version": 1,
            "purpose": "preparation only; no study authorized",
            "controller": "lsy_drone_racing.control.mpcc_broad_core.MPCCBroadCore",
            "checkout": str(CHECKOUT),
            "baseline_source": str(BASELINE),
            "cases": cases,
            "case_order": list(cases),
            "optional_comparator": baseline["near_tie_more_finishes"],
            "optional_comparator_enabled": False,
            "seeds": [],
            "bounds": {
                k: [round(baseline["fastest"]["mpcc"][k] * s, 12) for s in (0.8, 1.2)]
                for k in PARAMETERS
            },
            "target": {
                "after_crossing_occurrence": 3,
                "physical_gate_id_zero_based": 2,
                "third_center_anchor_index": 8,
                "third_departure_anchor_index": 9,
                "local_window_progress": [0, 1.44],
            },
            "diagnostics": [
                "departure gate-local signed depth, lateral and vertical position",
                "derivatives, curvature, derivative norm, physical length",
                "physical/virtual speed, tracking, saturation, required occurrence",
                "revision event and whole compute_control duration",
            ],
            "invariants": [
                "original lift endpoints _anchors[9:11]",
                "original waypoints",
                "all costs, speed, pole width, gate offset and nonfactor settings",
            ],
            "deferred": ["lift endpoint movement", "waypoint edits", "path-policy redesign"],
            "seeding": "future externally approved seed file; none allocated by preparation",
            "timing": "only original compute_control timed; diagnostics outside call",
            "hashes": sources(),
        }
        validate_plan(plan)
        return plan
    
    
    def validate_plan(plan):
        frozen = read(BASELINE)
        expected = frozen["fastest"]
        if plan["optional_comparator"] != frozen["near_tie_more_finishes"]:
            raise ValueError("Optional comparator changed")
        if plan["optional_comparator_enabled"] is not False:
            raise ValueError("Optional comparator requires separate reviewed plan")
        if plan["cases"]["baseline"] != expected or plan.get("seeds") != []:
            raise ValueError("Baseline or preparation seed policy changed")
        expected_names = ["baseline"] + [
            k + "_" + suffix for k in PARAMETERS for suffix in ("lower", "higher")
        ]
        if plan["case_order"] != expected_names or set(plan["cases"]) != set(expected_names):
            raise ValueError("Candidate set changed")
        for name, settings in plan["cases"].items():
            validate_case(settings)
            if name != "baseline":
                key, suffix = name.rsplit("_", 1)
                expected_value = round(
                    expected["mpcc"][key] * {"lower": 0.8, "higher": 1.2}[suffix], 12
                )
                if settings["mpcc"][key] != expected_value:
                    raise ValueError("Candidate value changed")
        if len({json.dumps(x, sort_keys=True) for x in plan["cases"].values()}) != 17:
            raise ValueError("Duplicate candidates")
    
    
    def synthetic_observation(config):
        import numpy as np
        from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
    
        return {
            "pos": np.array(config.env.track.drones[0]["pos"], dtype=float),
            "vel": np.zeros(3),
            "quat": np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0]),
            "ang_vel": np.zeros(3),
            "n_gates_passed": 0,
            "gates_pos": np.array([x["pos"] for x in config.env.track.gates]),
            "gates_quat": Rotation.from_euler(
                "xyz", [x["rpy"] for x in config.env.track.gates]
            ).as_quat(),
            "gates_visited": np.zeros(len(config.env.track.gates), dtype=bool),
            "obstacles_pos": np.array([x["pos"] for x in config.env.track.obstacles]),
            "obstacles_visited": np.zeros(len(config.env.track.obstacles), dtype=bool),
            "gate_sequence": np.array(config.env.track.gate_order),
        }
    
    
    def effective(controller, expected):
        actual = {
            "mpcc": dict(controller.settings),
            "mpcc_experiment": {k: getattr(controller, k) for k in expected["mpcc_experiment"]},
        }
        if actual != expected:
            raise ValueError("Effective controller settings differ")
        core = load_core()
        if type(controller) is not core.MPCCBroadCore:
            raise ValueError("Unexpected controller identity")
        return actual
    
    
    def fixture(output):
        """Exercise real path initialization/revisions; replace solver only in this fixture."""
        from types import SimpleNamespace
        from unittest.mock import patch
    
        import numpy as np
    
        core = load_core()
        from lsy_drone_racing.utils import load_config
    
        config = load_config(CHECKOUT / "config/level2.toml")
        obs = synthetic_observation(config)
        baseline = read(BASELINE)["fastest"]
        plan = read(HERE / "plan.json")
        results = []
        # Construction requires no Acados code generation; no control or simulation step.
        with patch.object(
            core, "create_mpcc_solver", return_value=(SimpleNamespace(reset=lambda: None), None)
        ):
            raw = core.MPCCBroadCore(
                obs, {}, config, settings=baseline["mpcc"], geometry=baseline["mpcc_experiment"]
            )
            for name, settings in plan["cases"].items():
                controller = core.MPCCBroadCore(
                    obs, {}, config, settings=settings["mpcc"], geometry=settings["mpcc_experiment"]
                )
                effective(controller, settings)
                if not np.array_equal(controller._anchors, raw._anchors):
                    raise ValueError("Anchors moved")
                if not np.array_equal(controller._base_path.c, raw._base_path.c):
                    raise ValueError("Nominal waypoints/path moved")
                if name == "baseline" and not np.array_equal(controller._path.c, raw._path.c):
                    raise ValueError("Baseline path coefficient mismatch")
                coeffs = controller._path.c.copy()
                controller._update_gate_path(obs)
                if not np.array_equal(controller._path.c, coeffs):
                    raise ValueError("No-change revision changed path")
                shifted = copy.deepcopy(obs)
                shifted["gates_visited"][2] = True
                shifted["gates_pos"][2, 2] += 0.03
                controller._update_gate_path(shifted)
                if controller._path_geometry_revision != 1:
                    raise ValueError("Revision did not propagate")
                if not np.isfinite(controller._path.c).all():
                    raise ValueError("Nonfinite path coefficients")
                start = controller._anchors[8]
                progress = np.linspace(start, min(start + 1.44, controller._length), 145)
                points = controller._path(progress)
                from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
    
                rotation = Rotation.from_quat(shifted["gates_quat"][2]).as_matrix()
                local = (points - shifted["gates_pos"][2]) @ rotation
                results.append(
                    {
                        "case": name,
                        "settings": settings,
                        "controller": type(controller).__module__ + "." + type(controller).__name__,
                        "revision": controller._path_geometry_revision,
                        "progress": progress.tolist(),
                        "gate_local_position_m": local.tolist(),
                        "anchor_sha256": hashlib.sha256(controller._anchors.tobytes()).hexdigest(),
                        "finite": True,
                    }
                )
        write(
            output,
            {
                "status": "passed",
                "solver": "fixture stub; never solved",
                "baseline_equivalence": "exact initialized spline coefficients only",
                "cases": results,
                "episodes": 0,
            },
        )
    
    
    def recorder_class():
        path = HERE.parent / "coordinate-v1/diagnostics.py"
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("departure_coordinate_diagnostics", path)
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        sys.modules[spec.name] = module
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        return module.DiagnosticRecorder
    
    
    def worker(request, output):
        """Future execution only: one configuration in a fresh process/generated directory."""
        import numpy as np
    
        request = read(request)
        plan = read(request["plan"])
        verify(plan)
        out = Path(output).resolve()
        out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
        generated = out / "generated"
        generated.mkdir()
        os.chdir(generated)
        core = load_core()
        import gymnasium
        from gymnasium.wrappers.jax_to_numpy import JaxToNumpy
    
        from lsy_drone_racing.utils import load_config
    
        settings = plan["cases"][request["case"]]
        config = load_config(CHECKOUT / "config/level2.toml")
        config.sim.render = False
        if config.env.freq != 50 or config.env.control_mode != "attitude":
            raise ValueError("Expected 50Hz attitude environment")
        env = JaxToNumpy(
            gymnasium.make(
                config.env.id,
                freq=config.env.freq,
                sim_config=config.sim,
                sensor_range=config.env.sensor_range,
                control_mode=config.env.control_mode,
                track=config.env.track,
                disturbances=config.env.get("disturbances"),
                randomizations=config.env.get("randomizations"),
                seed=request["seeds"][0],
            )
        )
        if env.unwrapped.settings.max_episode_steps != 1500:
            env.close()
            raise ValueError("Expected1500-step episode limit")
        rows = []
        try:
            for index, seed in enumerate(request["seeds"]):
                obs, info = env.reset(seed=seed)
                controller = core.MPCCBroadCore(
                    obs, info, config, settings=settings["mpcc"], geometry=settings["mpcc_experiment"]
                )
                actual = effective(controller, settings)
                recorder = recorder_class()(controller)
                recorder.capture_initial(obs)
                durations = []
                for step in range(1500):
                    recorder.before_control(obs)
                    before = time.perf_counter_ns()
                    action = controller.compute_control(obs, info)
                    duration = (time.perf_counter_ns() - before) / 1e6
                    durations.append(duration)
                    if not np.isfinite(action).all():
                        raise ValueError("Nonfinite action")
                    recorder.after_control(obs, action, duration_ms=duration)
                    obs, reward, terminated, truncated, info = env.step(action)
                    finished = controller.step_callback(
                        action, obs, reward, terminated, truncated, info
                    )
                    if finished or terminated or truncated:
                        break
                controller.episode_callback()
                episode_dir = out / f"episode-{index:03d}"
                recorder.write(episode_dir)
                rows.append(
                    {
                        "seed": seed,
                        "steps": step + 1,
                        "gates_passed": int(obs["n_gates_passed"]),
                        "success": int(obs["n_gates_passed"]) == 5,
                        "effective_settings": actual,
                        "compute_durations_ms": durations,
                        "controller_class": type(controller).__module__
                        + "."
                        + type(controller).__name__,
                    }
                )
                controller.episode_reset()
                write(out / "episodes.json", rows)
        finally:
            env.close()
        write(
            out / "generated-sha256.json",
            {str(p.relative_to(generated)): sha(p) for p in generated.rglob("*") if p.is_file()},
        )
    
    
    def run(plan_path, output, seeds_file, execute=False):
        plan_path = Path(plan_path).resolve()
        plan = read(plan_path)
        verify(plan)
        if not execute:
            return {
                "status": "dry-run passed",
                "cases": len(plan["cases"]),
                "episodes_started": 0,
                "seeds_allocated": 0,
                "future_requires": "explicit --execute and externally approved --seeds-file",
            }
        if seeds_file is None:
            raise ValueError("Externally approved seed file required")
        seeds = read(seeds_file)
        if not isinstance(seeds, list) or not seeds or any(type(x) is not int for x in seeds):
            raise ValueError("Seeds must be a nonempty integer list")
        if len(set(seeds)) != len(seeds):
            raise ValueError("Duplicate seeds")
        if output is None:
            raise ValueError("Fresh output directory required")
        diagnostics = HERE.parent / "coordinate-v1/diagnostics.py"
        if not diagnostics.is_file():
            raise ValueError("Coordinate diagnostic adapter missing")
        with (ROOT / "logs/mpcc-tuning/.combination.lock").open("r") as lock:
            fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
            out = Path(output).resolve()
            out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
            write(
                out / "execution-manifest.json",
                {
                    "plan_sha256": sha(plan_path),
                    "diagnostics_sha256": sha(diagnostics),
                    "seeds_file": str(Path(seeds_file).resolve()),
                    "seeds_sha256": sha(seeds_file),
                    "seeds": seeds,
                    "case_order": plan["case_order"],
                },
            )
            for name in plan["case_order"]:
                request = out / (name + "-request.json")
                write(request, {"plan": str(plan_path), "case": name, "seeds": seeds})
                with (out / (name + "-console.log")).open("w") as log:
                    subprocess.run(
                        [
                            sys.executable,
                            str(Path(__file__).resolve()),
                            "_worker",
                            str(request),
                            str(out / name),
                        ],
                        check=True,
                        env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1"),
                        stdout=log,
                        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    )
        return {"status": "completed", "cases": len(plan["cases"]), "episodes": len(seeds) * 17}
    
    
    def audit(plan_path):
        plan = read(plan_path)
        verify(plan)
        return {
            "status": "passed",
            "cases": len(plan["cases"]),
            "candidate_configurations_complete": True,
            "duplicates": 0,
            "source_hashes": len(plan["hashes"]),
            "episodes_audited": 0,
        }
    
    
    def main():
        parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
        sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
        sub.add_parser("prepare")
        sub.add_parser("fixture").add_argument("--output", required=True)
        check = sub.add_parser("audit")
        check.add_argument("--plan", default=str(HERE / "plan.json"))
        race = sub.add_parser("run")
        race.add_argument("--plan", default=str(HERE / "plan.json"))
        race.add_argument("--output")
        race.add_argument("--seeds-file")
        race.add_argument("--execute", action="store_true")
        hidden = sub.add_parser("_worker")
        hidden.add_argument("request")
        hidden.add_argument("output")
        args = parser.parse_args()
        if args.command == "prepare":
            plan = build_plan()
            destination = HERE / "plan.json"
            if destination.exists():
                raise FileExistsError("Frozen plan already exists")
            write(destination, plan)
            print(json.dumps({"status": "prepared", "cases": len(plan["cases"])}))
        elif args.command == "audit":
            print(json.dumps(audit(args.plan)))
        elif args.command == "fixture":
            fixture(args.output)
        elif args.command == "run":
            print(json.dumps(run(args.plan, args.output, args.seeds_file, args.execute)))
        else:
            worker(args.request, args.output)
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        main()

    """Lossless storage adapter for the unchanged shared diagnostic observer.
    
    The decoded primitive record has exactly the original JSON schema and values.
    Marshal format4 preserves native scalar types; XZ preset3 reduces numeric text overhead.
    """
    from pathlib import Path
    import sys,marshal,lzma,json
    
    def write(recorder,directory):
        directory=Path(directory);directory.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
        c=recorder.controller;clean=sys.modules[type(recorder).__module__].clean
        value=clean(dict(schema_version=1,controller_identity=dict(module=type(c).__module__,class_name=type(c).__qualname__,mro=[f'{t.__module__}.{t.__qualname__}' for t in type(c).__mro__]),effective_settings=dict(mpcc=dict(c.settings),mpcc_experiment={k:getattr(c,k) for k in ('gate_center_snap','over_gate_lift','observed_obstacle_clearance')}),geometry_records=recorder.geometry_records,tick_records=recorder.tick_records))
        path=directory/'diagnostics.json.marshal.xz'
        with lzma.open(path,'xb',preset=3) as f:marshal.dump(value,f,4)
        (directory/'encoding.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(encoding='Python marshal format4, XZ preset3',decoded_schema='Original DiagnosticRecorder schema_version1; all values/types preserved',python=sys.version),indent=2)+'\n')
        return path

    def read_episode(directory):
        """Read compact or any preserved full diagnostic encoding without conversion."""
        directory = Path(directory)
        compact = directory / "diagnostics.compact.json.gz"
        if compact.exists():
            with gzip.open(compact, "rt") as stream:
                return json.load(stream)
        archive = directory / "diagnostics.archive.json.gz"
        if archive.exists():
            with gzip.open(archive, "rt") as stream:
                return json.load(stream)
        plain = directory / "diagnostics.json"
        if plain.exists():
            return json.loads(plain.read_text())
        compressed = directory / "diagnostics.json.gz"
        if compressed.exists():
            with gzip.open(compressed, "rt") as stream:
                return json.load(stream)
        with lzma.open(directory / "diagnostics.json.marshal.xz", "rb") as stream:
            return marshal.load(stream)
    
    
    def audit_record(value):
        """Check declared compact grids, then reuse independent coordinate arithmetic."""
        if value["schema_version"] == 2:
            if value.get("logging_mode") != "compact":
                raise ValueError("Unknown version-2 diagnostic mode")
            for g in value["geometry_records"]:
                sampling = g["sampling"]
                if (
                    sampling["grid_kind"] != "bounded_diagnostic_stencil"
                    or sampling["global_points"] != 129
                    or sampling["departure_points"] != 65
                    or sampling["departure_window_sunit"] != 1.44
                ):
                    raise ValueError("Unrecognized compact sampling contract")
                lo, hi = sampling["domain"]
                expected = np.linspace(lo, hi, 129)
                anchors = np.asarray(g["gate_anchors_s"])
                if len(anchors) >= 11:
                    local = anchors[8] + np.linspace(0.0, 1.44, 65)
                    expected = np.r_[expected, local[(local >= lo) & (local <= hi)]]
                expected = np.unique(np.r_[expected, anchors])
                if not np.array_equal(np.asarray(g["s"]), expected):
                    raise ValueError("Compact sampling grid mismatch")
                if len(g["s"]) > 129 + 65 + len(anchors):
                    raise ValueError("Compact geometry sample budget exceeded")
            # Shared arithmetic is valid for either grid; never pass schema-2 files
            # directly to legacy dense-report tools, which have a different contract.
            shared_value = dict(value, schema_version=1)
        elif value["schema_version"] == 3:
            if value.get("logging_mode") != "archive_compact":
                raise ValueError("Unknown archive diagnostic mode")
            tick_hash = hashlib.sha256(
                json.dumps(
                    value["tick_records"], sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False
                ).encode()
            ).hexdigest()
            if tick_hash != value["archive"]["original_tick_records_sha256"]:
                raise ValueError("Archived tick records do not match their original digest")
            for g in value["geometry_records"]:
                sampling = g["sampling"]
                indices = sampling["original_sample_indices"]
                n = sampling["original_sample_count"]
                if (
                    sampling["grid_kind"] != "retained_dense_samples"
                    or len(indices) != len(g["s"])
                    or not indices
                    or indices[0] != 0
                    or indices[-1] != n - 1
                    or any(type(i) is not int for i in indices)

                    or len(indices) > 256 + len(g["gate_anchors_s"])
                    or g["dense_summary"]["sample_count"] != n
                ):
                    raise ValueError("Invalid retained archive grid")

                    ("curvature_per_m", "max_curvature_per_m"),
                    ("derivative_norm_m_per_sunit", "max_derivative_norm"),

    def module(name, path):
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
        value = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        sys.modules[name] = value
        spec.loader.exec_module(value)
        return value
    
    
    def historical():
        return module("compact_historical_runner", CAMPAIGN / "runner-v4.py")
    
    
    def compact_module():
        return module("compact_logging", HERE / "compact.py")
    
    
    def verify(plan):
        old = historical()
        old.verify(plan)
        compact_module().policy(plan)
        # Refuse an old frozen plan: using this version requires explicitly pinning it.
        required = [HERE / name for name in ("runner.py", "compact.py", "audit.py", "analyze.py")]
        required += [
            CAMPAIGN / name for name in ("runner-v4.py", "runner-v2.py", "diagnostic-export-v4.py")
        ]
        required.append(old.PREP / "coordinate-v1/diagnostics.py")
        for path in required:
            if plan["hashes"].get(str(path)) != old.sha(path):
                raise ValueError("New logging sources must be pinned in a NEW plan: " + str(path))
    
    
    def worker(request, output):
        old_runner = historical()
        req = old_runner.read(request)
        if old_runner.sha(req["plan"]) != req["plan_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Plan fingerprint mismatch")
        plan = old_runner.read(req["plan"])
        if req["seeds"] != plan["seeds"]:
            raise ValueError("Worker seed cohort mismatch")
        compact = compact_module()
        logging = compact.policy(plan)
        old = old_runner.adapter().original()
        old.verify = verify
        shared_factory = old.recorder_class
        seeds = iter(req["seeds"])
        full_export = module("compact_full_export", CAMPAIGN / "diagnostic-export-v4.py")
    
        def recorder_factory():
            shared_class = shared_factory()
            compact_class = compact.recorder_class(shared_class)
    
            def create(controller):
                seed = next(seeds)
                if logging["mode"] == "full" or seed in logging["full_diagnostic_seeds"]:
                    instance = shared_class(controller)
                    instance.write = types.MethodType(full_export.write, instance)
                    return instance
                return compact_class(controller)
    
            return create
    
        old.recorder_class = recorder_factory
        # Same verified controller, exact episode loop, callbacks and timing boundary.
        old.worker(request, output)
    
    
    def run(batch):
        old = historical()
        batch = Path(batch).resolve()
        decision = old.read(batch / "decision.json")
        path = Path(decision["source_plan"])
        if old.sha(path) != decision["source_plan_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Decision/plan fingerprint mismatch")
        plan = old.read(path)
        verify(plan)

        def eval_param_sens(self, index: int, stage: int=0, field="ex"):
            """
            Calculate the sensitivity of the current solution with respect to the initial state component of index.
    
            NOTE: Correct computation of sensitivities requires
    
            (1) HPIPM as QP solver,
    
            (2) the usage of an exact Hessian,
    
            (3) positive definiteness of the full-space Hessian if the square-root version of the Riccati recursion is used
                OR positive definiteness of the reduced Hessian if the classic Riccati recursion is used (compare: `solver_options.qp_solver_ric_alg`),
            (4) the solution of at least one QP in advance to evaluation of the sensitivities as the factorization is reused.
    
            :param index: integer corresponding to initial state index in range(nx)
            """

        def get(self, stage_: int, field_: str):
            """
            Get the last solution of the solver.
    
            :param stage: integer corresponding to shooting node

            .. note:: regarding lam: \n
                    the inequalities are internally organized in the following order: \n
                    [ lbu lbx lg lh lphi ubu ubx ug uh uphi; \n
                    lsbu lsbx lsg lsh lsphi usbu usbx usg ush usphi]
    
            .. note:: pi: multipliers for dynamics equality constraints \n
                          lam: multipliers for inequalities \n
                          sl: slack variables of soft lower inequality constraints \n
                          su: slack variables of soft upper inequality constraints \n
            """
    
            out_fields = ['x', 'u', 'z', 'pi', 'lam', 'sl', 'su']
            in_fields = ['p']
            sens_fields = ['sens_u', 'sens_x', 'sens_pi', 'sens_lam', 'sens_sl', 'sens_su']
            all_fields = out_fields + in_fields + sens_fields
    
            if (field_ not in all_fields):
                raise ValueError(f'AcadosOcpSolver.get(stage={stage_}, field={field_}): \'{field_}\' is an invalid argument.'
                                 f'\n Possible values are {all_fields}.')
    
            if not isinstance(stage_, int):
                raise TypeError(f'AcadosOcpSolver.get(stage={stage_}, field={field_}): stage index must be an integer, got type {type(stage_)}.')
    
            if stage_ < 0 or stage_ > self.N:
                raise ValueError(f'AcadosOcpSolver.get(stage={stage_}, field={field_}): stage index must be in [0, {self.N}], got: {stage_}.')
    
            if stage_ == self.N and field_ == 'pi':

            field = field_.replace('sens_', '') if field_ in sens_fields else field_
            field = field.encode('utf-8')
    
            dims = self.__acados_lib.ocp_nlp_dims_get_from_attr(self.nlp_config, self.nlp_dims, self.nlp_out, stage_, field)
    
            out = np.zeros((dims,), dtype=np.float64, order="C")

            return out

            """
            Get concatenation of all stages of last solution of the solver.

            """
            if field_ not in ['x', 'u', 'z', 'pi', 'lam', 'sl', 'su', 'p', 'p_global']:
                raise ValueError(f'AcadosOcpSolver.get_flat(field={field_}): \'{field_}\' is an invalid argument.')
    
            if field_ == 'p_global':
                if not self.__save_p_global:
                    raise ValueError(f'The field \'{field_}\' is not stored within the solver by default. Please set the option \'save_p_global=True\' when instantiating the solver.')

    import functools
    
    import numpy as np
    
    import gymnasium as gym

    class JaxToNumpy(ArrayConversion):
        """Wraps a Jax-based environment such that it can be interacted with NumPy arrays.
    
        Actions must be provided as numpy arrays and observations will be returned as numpy arrays.
        A vector version of the wrapper exists, :class:`gymnasium.wrappers.vector.JaxToNumpy`.
    
        Notes:
            The Jax To Numpy and Numpy to Jax conversion does not guarantee a roundtrip (jax -> numpy -> jax) and vice versa.
            The reason for this is jax does not support non-array values, therefore numpy ``int_32(5) -> DeviceArray([5], dtype=jnp.int23)``
    
        Example:
            >>> import gymnasium as gym                                     # doctest: +SKIP
            >>> env = gym.make("JaxEnv-vx")                                 # doctest: +SKIP
            >>> env = JaxToNumpy(env)                                       # doctest: +SKIP
            >>> obs, _ = env.reset(seed=123)                                # doctest: +SKIP
            >>> type(obs)                                                   # doctest: +SKIP
            <class 'numpy.ndarray'>
            >>> action = env.action_space.sample()                          # doctest: +SKIP
            >>> obs, reward, terminated, truncated, info = env.step(action) # doctest: +SKIP
            >>> type(obs)                                                   # doctest: +SKIP
            <class 'numpy.ndarray'>
            >>> type(reward)                                                # doctest: +SKIP
            <class 'float'>
            >>> type(terminated)                                            # doctest: +SKIP
            <class 'bool'>
            >>> type(truncated)                                             # doctest: +SKIP
            <class 'bool'>
    
        Change logs:
         * v1.0.0 - Initially added
        """
    
        def __init__(self, env: gym.Env[ObsType, ActType]):
            """Wraps a jax environment such that the input and outputs are numpy arrays.
    
            Args:
                env: the jax environment to wrap
            """
            if jnp is None:
                raise DependencyNotInstalled(
                    'Jax is not installed, run `pip install "gymnasium[jax]"`'
                )
            # Recorded here rather than left to `ArrayConversion`, whose four
            # arguments this constructor does not take. The first call wins, so
            # the one below is ignored.
            gym.utils.RecordConstructorArgs.__init__(self)
            super().__init__(env=env, env_xp=jnp, target_xp=np)

            """

            Available fields:
                - time_tot: total CPU time previous call
                - time_lin: CPU time for linearization
                - time_sim: CPU time for integrator
                - time_sim_ad: CPU time for integrator contribution of external function calls
                - time_sim_la: CPU time for integrator contribution of linear algebra
                - time_qp: CPU time qp solution
                - time_qp_solver_call: CPU time inside qp solver (without converting the QP)
                - time_qp_xcond: time_glob: CPU time globalization
                - time_qpscaling: CPU time for QP scaling
                - time_solution_sensitivities: CPU time for previous call to eval_param_sens
                - time_solution_sens_lin: CPU time for linearization in eval_param_sens
                - time_solution_sens_solve: CPU time for solving in eval_solution_sensitivity
                - time_reg: CPU time regularization
                - time_preparation: CPU time for last preparation phase, relevant for (AS-)RTI, zero otherwise
                - time_feedback: CPU time for last feedback phase, relevant for (AS-)RTI, otherwise returns total compuation time.
                - sqp_iter: number of SQP iterations
                - nlp_iter: number of NLP solver iterations (DDP or SQP)
                - qp_stat: vector of QP solver status for last NLP solver call

    # Compact campaign logging v5
    
    This is a **new, opt-in runner version for future frozen plans**, with compact logging
    as its default. It does not change historical runners, completed data, production
    configuration, controller methods, solver costs, progress coordinates, or warm starts.
    No campaign is resumed by installing or testing these files.
    
    ## What changes
    
    - Every control tick still retains command, solver status, fallback availability,
      compute duration, observed position, physical/virtual speed, tracking errors,
      curvature at actual progress, saturation flags, and required gate occurrence.
    - Every path revision still gets a geometry record, including path-identity changes
      and revision-number reuse. Geometry sampling is bounded to 129 global points,
      65 points in the third departure window, and every anchor (at most 211 points for
      the current 17-anchor course), instead of four points per every dense spline interval.
    - The same shared `sample_path` and inherited per-tick `after_control` implementation
      are used. A read-only sampling view supplies a diagnostic grid; it is never passed
      to the controller. All observer work remains outside the unchanged compute timer.
    - Compact output is schema 2 in `diagnostics.compact.json.gz` (gzip level 1).
      Already-normalized records are streamed without another full recursive clean/copy.
    - Full schema-1 diagnostics are available for explicitly preselected seed identifiers
      or an entirely full diagnostic batch; they use the existing lossless full exporter.
    
    The bounded grid can miss narrow curvature peaks. Its sampled lengths and extrema
    must not be treated as the same estimates as historical dense logs. Use the full mode
    for detailed geometry investigations; compact mode is intended for broader screening.
    
    ## Frozen logging policy
    
    Add this to a NEW plan and its decision:
    
    ```json
    {"logging": {"mode": "compact", "full_diagnostic_seeds": []}}
    ```
    
    To retain full diagnostics on selected matched seeds, list their actual seed IDs
    before execution. The same list applies to each configuration. `mode: "full"` retains
    full diagnostics everywhere. The default is compact when the logging key is omitted,
    but recording the explicit policy in both plan and decision is recommended. Full
    logging cannot be selected retroactively from favorable or failed outcomes.
    
    The new runner **refuses old frozen plans**. Pin absolute paths and SHA256 hashes for
    `runner.py`, `compact.py`, `audit.py`, and `analyze.py` in a new plan. Also pin the existing
    `runner-v4.py`, `runner-v2.py`, `diagnostic-export-v4.py`, shared `diagnostics.py`, and
    the normal controller/source/runtime inputs. Update `decision.runner_sha256`
    and freeze its normal configurations, sample sizes, order, seeds, and analysis.
    
    Use the recorded historical runtime activation environment. Invocation syntax is:
    
    ```text
    python /path/to/campaign/logging-v5/runner.py run /absolute/path/to/NEW-batch
    python /path/to/campaign/logging-v5/analyze.py /absolute/path/to/NEW-batch /absolute/path/to/NEW-report
    python /path/to/campaign/logging-v5/audit.py /absolute/path/to/NEW-batch/run-v1/CASE
    ```
    
    These are usage examples, not authorization or instructions to launch an experiment.
    The runner retains the shared simulation lock, fresh processes/generated directories,
    the original episode loop, and exact core/effective-setting checks. Its manifest records
    the resolved logging policy. Mixed compact/full files are read by the new audit adapter;
    do not feed schema-2 files directly into old dense-schema analyzers/report scripts.
    
    The generic analyzer retains numerical/latency screening, exact completion intervals,
    paired bootstrap/rescue/regression reports, reference-only exclusions, and common-success
    checks. It checks fingerprints/settings/seeds/artifacts and observed initial-state
    matching. Batch-specific independent configuration reconstruction and hypothesis review
    remain separate required checks; this generic reader does not replace those safeguards.
    It does not implement the separately proposed new numerical solver-options adapter.

        def dump_last_qp_to_json(self, filename: str = '', overwrite=False):
            """
            Dumps the latest QP data into a json file
    
            :param filename: if not set, use name + timestamp + '.json'
            :param overwrite: if false and filename exists add timestamp to filename
            """
            if filename == '':
                filename = f'{self.name}_QP.json'
    
            if not overwrite:
                # append timestamp
                if os.path.isfile(filename):
                    filename = filename[:-5]
                    filename += datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d-%H:%M:%S.%f') + '.json'
    
            # get QP data:
            qp_data = self.get_last_qp()
    
            # save
            with open(filename, 'w') as f:
                json.dump(qp_data, f, default=make_object_json_dumpable, indent=4, sort_keys=True)
            print("stored qp from solver memory in ", os.path.join(os.getcwd(), filename))
    
        def get_last_qp(self) -> dict:
            """
            Returns the latest QP data as a dict
            """
            # get QP data:
            qp_data = dict()
    
            lN = len(str(self.N+1))
            for field in self.__qp_dynamics_fields:
                for i in range(self.N):
                    qp_data[f'{field}_{i:0{lN}d}'] = self.get_from_qp_in(i,field)
    
            for field in self.__qp_constraint_fields | self.__qp_cost_fields | self.__qp_constraint_int_fields:
                for i in range(self.N+1):
                    qp_data[f'{field}_{i:0{lN}d}'] = self.get_from_qp_in(i,field)
    
            # remove empty fields
            for k in list(qp_data.keys()):
                if len(qp_data[k]) == 0:
                    del qp_data[k]
    
            return qp_data
    
    
        def get_last_relaxed_qp(self) -> dict:
            """
            Returns the latest relaxed QP data as a dict
            """
            # get QP data:
            qp_data = dict()
    
            lN = len(str(self.N+1))
            for field in self.__relaxed_qp_dynamics_fields:
                for i in range(self.N):
                    qp_data[f'{field}_{i:0{lN}d}'] = self.get_from_qp_in(i,field)
    
            for field in self.__relaxed_qp_constraint_fields | self.__relaxed_qp_cost_fields | self.__relaxed_qp_constraint_int_fields:
                for i in range(self.N+1):
                    qp_data[f'{field}_{i:0{lN}d}'] = self.get_from_qp_in(i,field)
    
            # remove empty fields
            for k in list(qp_data.keys()):
                if len(qp_data[k]) == 0:
                    del qp_data[k]
    
            return qp_data
    
    
        def load_iterate(self, filename:str, verbose: bool = True):
    
            value_data = cast(value_.ctypes.data, POINTER(c_double))
            value_data_p = cast((value_data), c_void_p)
    
            self.__acados_lib.ocp_nlp_constraints_model_set(self.nlp_config, \
                self.nlp_dims, self.nlp_in, self.nlp_out, stage, field, value_data_p)
    
            return
    
    
        def get_hessian_block(self, stage: int) -> np.ndarray:
            """
            Get Hessian block from last QP at stage i
            In HPIPM form [[R, S^T], [S, Q]]
            """
            Q_mat = self.get_from_qp_in(stage, 'Q')
            R_mat = self.get_from_qp_in(stage, 'R')
            S_mat = self.get_from_qp_in(stage, 'S')
            hess_block = scipy.linalg.block_diag(R_mat, Q_mat)
            nu = R_mat.shape[0]
            hess_block[nu:, :nu] = S_mat.T
            hess_block[:nu, nu:] = S_mat
            return hess_block
    
    
        def get_from_qp_in(self, stage_: int, field_: str):
            """
            Get numerical data from the current QP.
    
            :param stage: integer corresponding to shooting node
            :param field: string in ['A', 'B', 'b', 'Q', 'R', 'S', 'q', 'r', 'C', 'D', 'lg', 'ug', 'lbx', 'ubx', 'lbu', 'ubu']
    
            Note:
            - additional supported fields are ['P', 'K', 'Lr'], which can be extracted form QP solver PARTIAL_CONDENSING_HPIPM.
            - for PARTIAL_CONDENSING_* QP solvers, the following additional fields are available: ['pcond_Q', 'pcond_R', 'pcond_S']
            """
            if not isinstance(stage_, int):
                raise TypeError("stage should be int")
            if stage_ > self.N:
                raise ValueError("stage should be <= self.N")
            if field_ in self.__qp_dynamics_fields and stage_ >= self.N:
                raise ValueError(f"dynamics field {field_} not available at terminal stage")
            if field_ not in self.__all_qp_fields | self.__all_relaxed_qp_fields:
                raise ValueError(f"field {field_} not supported.")
            if field_ in self.__qp_pc_hpipm_fields:
                if self.__solver_options["qp_solver"] != "PARTIAL_CONDENSING_HPIPM" or self.__solver_options["qp_solver_cond_N"] != self.N:
                    raise ValueError(f"field {field_} only works for PARTIAL_CONDENSING_HPIPM QP solver with qp_solver_cond_N == N.")
                if field_ in ["P", "K", "p"] and stage_ == 0 and self.__nbxe_0 > 0:
                    raise ValueError(f"getting field {field_} at stage 0 only works without x0 elimination (see nbxe_0).")
            if field_ in self.__qp_pc_fields and not self.__solver_options["qp_solver"].startswith("PARTIAL_CONDENSING"):
                raise ValueError(f"field {field_} only works for PARTIAL_CONDENSING QP solvers.")
            if field_ in self.__all_relaxed_qp_fields and not self.__solver_options["nlp_solver_type"] == "SQP_WITH_FEASIBLE_QP":
                raise ValueError(f"field {field_} only works for SQP_WITH_FEASIBLE_QP nlp_solver_type.")
    
            field = field_.encode('utf-8')
            stage = c_int(stage_)
    
            # get dims
            dims = np.zeros((2,), dtype=np.intc, order="C")
            dims_data = cast(dims.ctypes.data, POINTER(c_int))
    
            self.__acados_lib.ocp_nlp_qp_dims_get_from_attr(self.nlp_config, \
                self.nlp_dims, self.nlp_out, stage_, field, dims_data)
    
            # create output data
            if field_ in self.__qp_constraint_int_fields | self.__relaxed_qp_constraint_int_fields:
                out = np.zeros((np.prod(dims),), dtype=np.int32, order="C")
            else:
                out = np.zeros((np.prod(dims),), dtype=np.float64, order="C")
            out = out.reshape(dims[0], dims[1], order='F')
    
            out_data = cast(out.ctypes.data, POINTER(c_double))
            out_data_p = cast((out_data), c_void_p)
    
            # call getter
            self.__acados_lib.ocp_nlp_get_at_stage(self.nlp_solver, stage, field, out_data_p)
    
            if field_ in ["Q", "R", "relaxed_Q", "relaxed_R"]:
                # make symmetric: copy lower triangular part to upper triangular part
                out = np.tril(out) + np.tril(out, -1).T
    
            return out
    
    
        def get_qp_scaling_constraints(self, stage: int) -> np.ndarray:
            """
            If the solver performs QP scaling, this function returns the scaling factors for the constraints.
            Bounds are not scaled, so the dimension is ng + nh + nphi.
            Only available if qpscaling_scale_constraints != NO_CONSTRAINT_SCALING.
            """
            if self.__solver_options["qpscaling_scale_constraints"] == "NO_CONSTRAINT_SCALING":
                raise ValueError(f"get_qp_scaling_constraints: only works if qpscaling_scale_constraints != NO_CONSTRAINT_SCALING.")
    
            # call getter
            field_ = "qpscaling_constr"
            field = field_.encode('utf-8')
            dims = self.dims_get(field_, stage)
            out = np.zeros((dims,), dtype=np.float64, order="C")
            out_data = cast(out.ctypes.data, POINTER(c_double))
            out_data_p = cast((out_data), c_void_p)
            self.__acados_lib.ocp_nlp_get_at_stage(self.nlp_solver, stage, field, out_data_p)
    
            return out
    
    
        def get_qp_scaling_objective(self) -> float:
            """
            Returns the cost scaling value corresponding to the previous QP solution.
            Only available if qpscaling_scale_objective != NO_OBJECTIVE_SCALING.
            """
            if self.__solver_options["qpscaling_scale_objective"] == "NO_OBJECTIVE_SCALING":
                raise ValueError("get_qp_scaling_objective: only works for QP solvers with qpscaling_scale_objective != NO_OBJECTIVE_SCALING.")
    
            # create output array
            out = np.zeros((1,), dtype=np.float64, order="C")
            out_data = cast(out.ctypes.data, POINTER(c_double))
    
            # call getter
            field = "qpscaling_obj".encode('utf-8')
            self.__acados_lib.ocp_nlp_get_at_stage(self.nlp_solver, 0, field, out_data)
    
            return out[0]
    
        def __ocp_nlp_get_from_iterate(self, iteration_, stage_, field_):
            stage = c_int(stage_)
            field = field_.encode('utf-8')
            iteration = c_int(iteration_)
            dim = self.__acados_lib.ocp_nlp_dims_get_from_attr(self.nlp_config, self.nlp_dims, self.nlp_out,
                        stage, field)
    
            out = np.zeros((dim,), dtype=np.float64, order="C")
            out_data = cast(out.ctypes.data, POINTER(c_double))
            out_data_p = cast((out_data), c_void_p)
            self.__acados_lib.ocp_nlp_get_from_iterate(self.nlp_solver, iteration, stage, field, out_data_p)
            return out
    
        def get_iterate(self, iteration: int) -> AcadosOcpIterate:
    
            nlp_iter = self.get_stats('nlp_iter')
            if iteration < -1 or iteration > nlp_iter:
                raise ValueError("get_iterate: iteration needs to be nonnegative and <= nlp_iter or -1.")
    
            if not self.__solver_options["store_iterates"]:
                raise ValueError("get_iterate: the solver option store_iterates needs to be true in order to get iterates.")
    
            if self.__solver_options["nlp_solver_type"] == "SQP_RTI":
                raise NotImplementedError("get_iterate: SQP_RTI not supported.")
    
            # set to nlp_iter if -1
            iteration = nlp_iter if iteration == -1 else iteration
    
            x_traj = []
            u_traj = []
            z_traj = []
            sl_traj = []
            su_traj = []
            pi_traj = []
            lam_traj = []
    
            for n in range(self.N):
                x_traj.append(self.__ocp_nlp_get_from_iterate(iteration, n, "x"))
                u_traj.append(self.__ocp_nlp_get_from_iterate(iteration, n, "u"))
                z_traj.append(self.__ocp_nlp_get_from_iterate(iteration, n, "z"))
                sl_traj.append(self.__ocp_nlp_get_from_iterate(iteration, n, "sl"))
                su_traj.append(self.__ocp_nlp_get_from_iterate(iteration, n, "su"))
                pi_traj.append(self.__ocp_nlp_get_from_iterate(iteration, n, "pi"))
                lam_traj.append(self.__ocp_nlp_get_from_iterate(iteration, n, "lam"))
    
            n = self.N
            x_traj.append(self.__ocp_nlp_get_from_iterate(iteration, n, "x"))
            sl_traj.append(self.__ocp_nlp_get_from_iterate(iteration, n, "sl"))

    def install(core,case,options,instrument=True):
     import numpy as np

         try:record[key]=np.asarray(s.get_stats(key)).tolist()
         except Exception as e:record[key]=dict(unavailable=type(e).__name__+': '+str(e))

        record['diagnostic_ms']=(time.perf_counter_ns()-start)/1e6

       s.solve=observed_solve

    void ocp_qp_hpipm_opts_set(void *config_, void *opts_, const char *field, void *value)
    {
        ocp_qp_hpipm_opts *opts = opts_;
    
        const char *mode;
        if (!strcmp(field, "hpipm_mode"))
        {
            mode = (const char *) value;
            if (!strcmp(mode, "BALANCE"))
                d_ocp_qp_ipm_arg_set_default(BALANCE, opts->hpipm_opts);
            else if (!strcmp(mode, "SPEED"))
                d_ocp_qp_ipm_arg_set_default(SPEED, opts->hpipm_opts);
            else if (!strcmp(mode, "SPEED_ABS"))
                d_ocp_qp_ipm_arg_set_default(SPEED_ABS, opts->hpipm_opts);
            else if (!strcmp(mode, "ROBUST"))
                d_ocp_qp_ipm_arg_set_default(ROBUST, opts->hpipm_opts);
    
            ocp_qp_hpipm_opts_overwrite_mode_opts(opts);
    
        }
        else if (!strcmp(field, "print_level"))
        {
            int* print_level = (int *) value;
            opts->print_level = *print_level;
        }
        else
        {
            d_ocp_qp_ipm_arg_set((char *) field, value, opts->hpipm_opts);
        }
    
        return;
    }

        """Offline QP inspection: no controller, simulator or solver construction."""
        import json,hashlib
        from pathlib import Path
        import numpy as np
        from scipy.optimize import linprog
        from scipy.linalg import eigvalsh
        H=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
        
        def stages(z):return [{k[3:-3]:z[k] for k in z.files if k.startswith('qp.') and k.endswith(f'_{i:02d}')} for i in range(41)]
        def reduced(z):
         st=stages(z);N=40;nx=17;nu=5;nv=N*nu
         E=np.zeros((nx,nv));d=st[0]['lbx'].ravel().copy();assert np.array_equal(d,st[0]['ubx'].ravel())
         HH=np.zeros((nv,nv));gg=np.zeros(nv);G=[];lo=[];hi=[];labels=[]
         for i,q in enumerate(st):
          U=np.zeros((nu,nv)) if i<N else np.zeros((0,nv))
          if i<N:U[:,i*nu:(i+1)*nu]=np.eye(nu)
          Q=q['Q'];R=q.get('R',np.zeros((0,0)));S=q.get('S',np.zeros((0,nx)))
          HH+=E.T@Q@E+U.T@R@U+U.T@S@E+E.T@S.T@U
          gg+=E.T@(Q@d+q['q'].ravel())+U.T@(S@d+q['r'].ravel())
          idx=q['idxb'].ravel();nbu=q.get('lbu',np.zeros(0)).size
          for j,ind in enumerate(idx):
           if j<nbu:
            G.append(U[ind]);lo.append(q['lbu'].ravel()[j]);hi.append(q['ubu'].ravel()[j]);labels.append((i,'u',int(ind)))
           else:
            ix=int(ind-U.shape[0]);k=j-nbu
            G.append(E[ix]);lo.append(q['lbx'].ravel()[k]-d[ix]);hi.append(q['ubx'].ravel()[k]-d[ix]);labels.append((i,'x',ix))
          if i<N:E=q['A']@E+q['B']@U;d=q['A']@d+q['b'].ravel()
         return HH,gg,np.array(G),np.array(lo),np.array(hi),labels
        
        def analyze(path):
         z=np.load(path);st=stages(z);nonfinite=[k for k in z.files if k.startswith('qp.') and not np.isfinite(z[k]).all()];inconsistent=[];eigs=[];hdiag=[];scales={}
         for k in z.files:
          if k.startswith('qp.'):
           a=np.abs(z[k]).ravel();nz=a[(a>0)&np.isfinite(a)]
           if nz.size:scales[k]=[float(nz.min()),float(nz.max())]
         for i,q in enumerate(st):
          for l,u in [('lbx','ubx'),('lbu','ubu'),('lg','ug')]:
           if l in q and np.any(q[l].ravel()>q[u].ravel()):inconsistent.append([i,l])
          Q=q['Q'];R=q.get('R',np.zeros((0,0)));S=q.get('S',np.zeros((0,17)));hb=np.block([[R,S],[S.T,Q]]);ee=eigvalsh(hb);eigs.append([float(ee.min()),float(ee.max()),int(np.sum(ee>1e-10*max(ee.max(),1))) ,len(ee)]);hdiag.extend(hb.diagonal())
         hh,g,G,l,u,labels=reduced(z);ev=eigvalsh(hh);A=np.r_[G,-G];b=np.r_[u,-l]
         lp=linprog(np.zeros(200),A_ub=A,b_ub=b,bounds=[(None,None)]*200,method='highs')
         # Minimal uniform relaxation of predicted roll/pitch/yaw bounds only, radians.
         relax=np.array([1. if stage>0 and typ=='x' and idx in [3,4,5] else 0. for stage,typ,idx in labels]);ar=np.c_[A,-np.r_[relax,relax]]
         opt=linprog(np.r_[np.zeros(200),1.],A_ub=ar,b_ub=b,bounds=[(None,None)]*200+[(0,None)],method='highs')
         diag=np.diag(hh);positive=np.maximum(diag,1e-16);scale=1/np.sqrt(positive);es=eigvalsh(scale[:,None]*hh*scale[None,:])
         return dict(path=str(path.relative_to(H)),sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),seed=int(z['seed']),tick=int(z['tick']),rti_pass=int(z['rti_pass']),status=int(z['status']),nonfinite=nonfinite,inconsistent_bounds=inconsistent,stage_hessian_eigen_rank=eigs,coefficient_ranges=scales,reduced_eigen_min=float(ev.min()),reduced_eigen_max=float(ev.max()),reduced_condition=float(ev.max()/ev.min()) if ev.min()>0 else None,diagonal_scaled_reduced_condition=float(es.max()/es.min()) if es.min()>0 else None,linear_feasibility_status=lp.status,linear_feasibility_message=lp.message,min_attitude_bound_relaxation_rad=float(opt.x[-1]) if opt.success else None,relaxation_lp_status=opt.status)
        
        if __name__=='__main__':
         selected=[];inventory=[]
         for folder in sorted((H/'run/default').glob('*-qps')):
          files=sorted(folder.glob('*.npz'));success=[];chosen=set()

           with np.load(p) as z:status=int(z['status']);assert bool(z['getter_state_equal']) and bool(z['getter_qp_equal'])
           inventory.append(dict(path=str(p.relative_to(H)),status=status))

    void ocp_qp_xcond_solver_opts_update(void *config_, ocp_qp_xcond_solver_dims *dims, void *opts_)
    {
        ocp_qp_xcond_solver_config *config = config_;
        qp_solver_config *qp_solver = config->qp_solver;
        ocp_qp_xcond_config *xcond = config->xcond;
    
        void *xcond_qp_dims;
        xcond->dims_get(xcond, dims->xcond_dims, "xcond_dims", &xcond_qp_dims);
    
        // xcond solver opts
        ocp_qp_xcond_solver_opts *opts = (ocp_qp_xcond_solver_opts *) opts_;
        // xcond opts
        xcond->opts_update(dims->xcond_dims, opts->xcond_opts);
        // qp solver opts
        qp_solver->opts_update(qp_solver, xcond_qp_dims, opts->qp_solver_opts);
    }
    
    
    
    void ocp_qp_xcond_solver_opts_set_(void *config_, void *opts_, const char *field, void* value)
    {
        ocp_qp_xcond_solver_opts *opts = (ocp_qp_xcond_solver_opts *) opts_;
        ocp_qp_xcond_solver_config *config = config_;
        qp_solver_config *qp_solver = config->qp_solver;
        ocp_qp_xcond_config *xcond = config->xcond;
    
        char *ptr_module = NULL;
        int module_length = 0;
        char module[MAX_STR_LEN];
        extract_module_name(field, module, &module_length, &ptr_module);
    
        if( ptr_module!=NULL && (!strcmp(ptr_module, "cond")) ) // pass options to condensing module // TODO rename xcond ???
        {
            xcond->opts_set(opts->xcond_opts, field+module_length+1, value);
        }
        else if (!strcmp(field, "initialize_next_xcond_qp_from_qp_out"))
        {
            bool* initialize_next_xcond_qp_from_qp_out = (bool *) value;
            opts->initialize_next_xcond_qp_from_qp_out = *initialize_next_xcond_qp_from_qp_out;
        }
        else // pass options to QP module
        {
            qp_solver->opts_set(qp_solver, opts->qp_solver_opts, field, value);
        }
    
        return;
    
    }

        {
        // extract dim
        int *nbu = qp->dim->nbu;
        int *nbxe = qp->dim->nbxe;
        int *nbue = qp->dim->nbue;
        int *nge = qp->dim->nge;
    
        int ii;
        for(ii=0; ii<nbxe[stage]; ii++)
            qp->idxe[stage][nbue[stage]+ii] = nbu[stage] + idxbxe[ii];
    
        return;
        }

    void ocp_nlp_add_levenberg_marquardt_term(ocp_nlp_config *config, ocp_nlp_dims *dims,
        ocp_nlp_in *in, ocp_nlp_out *out, ocp_nlp_opts *opts, ocp_nlp_memory *mem,
        ocp_nlp_workspace *work, double alpha, int iter, ocp_qp_in *qp_in)
    {
        double scaling_factor;
        if (opts->with_adaptive_levenberg_marquardt)
        {
            adaptive_levenberg_marquardt_update_mu(iter, alpha, opts, mem);
            double reg_param = opts->adaptive_levenberg_marquardt_obj_scalar*mem->cost_value*mem->adaptive_levenberg_marquardt_mu;
            opts->levenberg_marquardt = reg_param;
        }
        // Only add the Levenberg-Marquardt term when it is bigger than zero
        if (mem->compute_hess && opts->levenberg_marquardt > 0.0)
        {
            int N = dims->N;
            int *nx = dims->nx;
            int *nu = dims->nu;
            for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++)
            {
                config->cost[i]->model_get(config->cost[i], dims->cost[i], in->cost[i], "scaling", &scaling_factor);
                // Levenberg Marquardt term: scaling_factor * levenberg_marquardt * eye()
                blasfeo_ddiare(nu[i] + nx[i], scaling_factor * opts->levenberg_marquardt,
                                mem->qp_in->RSQrq+i, 0, 0);
            }
        } // else: do nothing
    }

        inspection=read(H/'inspection.json');independent=[]

         def q(key,i,default=None):return z.get(f'qp.{key}_{i:02d}',default)
         bounds=[(None,None)]*897;E=lil_matrix((680,897));rhs=np.zeros(680)
         for i in range(41):
          nu=5 if i<40 else 0;base=22*i;idx=q('idxb',i).ravel();lb=np.r_[q('lbu',i,np.zeros(0)).ravel(),q('lbx',i).ravel()];ub=np.r_[q('ubu',i,np.zeros(0)).ravel(),q('ubx',i).ravel()]
          for j,k in enumerate(idx):bounds[base+int(k)]=(lb[j],ub[j])
          if i<40:
           nbase=22*(i+1)+(5 if i<39 else 0);row=slice(17*i,17*(i+1));E[row,base+5:base+22]=-q('A',i);E[row,base:base+5]=-q('B',i);E[row,nbase:nbase+17]=np.eye(17);rhs[row]=q('b',i).ravel()

    # Compact campaign logging v5
    
    This is a **new, opt-in runner version for future frozen plans**, with compact logging
    as its default. It does not change historical runners, completed data, production
    configuration, controller methods, solver costs, progress coordinates, or warm starts.
    No campaign is resumed by installing or testing these files.
    
    ## What changes
    
    - Every control tick still retains command, solver status, fallback availability,
      compute duration, observed position, physical/virtual speed, tracking errors,
      curvature at actual progress, saturation flags, and required gate occurrence.
    - Every path revision still gets a geometry record, including path-identity changes
      and revision-number reuse. Geometry sampling is bounded to 129 global points,
      65 points in the third departure window, and every anchor (at most 211 points for
      the current 17-anchor course), instead of four points per every dense spline interval.
    - The same shared `sample_path` and inherited per-tick `after_control` implementation
      are used. A read-only sampling view supplies a diagnostic grid; it is never passed
      to the controller. All observer work remains outside the unchanged compute timer.
    - Compact output is schema 2 in `diagnostics.compact.json.gz` (gzip level 1).
      Already-normalized records are streamed without another full recursive clean/copy.
    - Full schema-1 diagnostics are available for explicitly preselected seed identifiers
      or an entirely full diagnostic batch; they use the existing lossless full exporter.
    
    The bounded grid can miss narrow curvature peaks. Its sampled lengths and extrema
    must not be treated as the same estimates as historical dense logs. Use the full mode
    for detailed geometry investigations; compact mode is intended for broader screening.
    
    ## Frozen logging policy
    
    Add this to a NEW plan and its decision:
    
    ```json
    {"logging": {"mode": "compact", "full_diagnostic_seeds": []}}
    ```
    
    To retain full diagnostics on selected matched seeds, list their actual seed IDs
    before execution. The same list applies to each configuration. `mode: "full"` retains
    full diagnostics everywhere. The default is compact when the logging key is omitted,
    but recording the explicit policy in both plan and decision is recommended. Full
    logging cannot be selected retroactively from favorable or failed outcomes.
    
    The new runner **refuses old frozen plans**. Pin absolute paths and SHA256 hashes for
    `runner.py`, `compact.py`, `audit.py`, and `analyze.py` in a new plan. Also pin the existing
    `runner-v4.py`, `runner-v2.py`, `diagnostic-export-v4.py`, shared `diagnostics.py`, and
    the normal controller/source/runtime inputs. Update `decision.runner_sha256`
    and freeze its normal configurations, sample sizes, order, seeds, and analysis.
    
    Use the recorded historical runtime activation environment. Invocation syntax is:
    
    ```text
    python /path/to/campaign/logging-v5/runner.py run /absolute/path/to/NEW-batch
    python /path/to/campaign/logging-v5/analyze.py /absolute/path/to/NEW-batch /absolute/path/to/NEW-report
    python /path/to/campaign/logging-v5/audit.py /absolute/path/to/NEW-batch/run-v1/CASE
    ```
    
    These are usage examples, not authorization or instructions to launch an experiment.
    The runner retains the shared simulation lock, fresh processes/generated directories,
    the original episode loop, and exact core/effective-setting checks. Its manifest records
    the resolved logging policy. Mixed compact/full files are read by the new audit adapter;
    do not feed schema-2 files directly into old dense-schema analyzers/report scripts.
    
    The generic analyzer retains numerical/latency screening, exact completion intervals,
    paired bootstrap/rescue/regression reports, reference-only exclusions, and common-success
    checks. It checks fingerprints/settings/seeds/artifacts and observed initial-state
    matching. Batch-specific independent configuration reconstruction and hypothesis review
    remain separate required checks; this generic reader does not replace those safeguards.
    It does not implement the separately proposed new numerical solver-options adapter.

    # Frozen-QP diagnosis of the exact faster parent
    
    Completed exactly **two instrumented diagnostic racing episodes**, both default numerics, on selected seeds1606110700 and1606110739. No further racing, replay, smoke or closed-loop-equivalence episode was run. Subsequent tests solved saved mathematical QPs offline only. No prediction/adaptation screen or fresh racing screen was launched.
    
    ## Result
    
    The failures are associated with **infeasible frozen QPs caused by hard future attitude-state bounds that cannot be reached from the current state under admissible commands**. This is established for the captured QPs by independent full-space and condensed linear-feasibility checks, and direct one-step interval certificates. It does not establish infeasibility of the full nonlinear flight problem or measure racing performance of a repair.
    
    Stronger LM and constant objective scaling did not repair any failed QP. Softening only future attitude-state bounds solved every failed frozen QP in the tested range of slack penalties. This is a plausible **formulation** repair, not a numerical-options-only fix or an approved flight configuration.
    
    ## Two-episode capture and preservation
    
    The complete parent came from departure-speed-20261104-v1/batch-004/decision.json, S30_RTI3_A875, and was checked against the frozen historical plan and source fingerprints. Its reference3.0/cap3.2/angle.875/RTI3/pressure12, departure depth.25, costs, geometry, path policy and adaptation were unchanged. The original established departure-v1/harness.py worker and original shared observer executed the episodes through a new versioned research adapter. Production and historical sources were preserved.
    
    Construction-only equivalence/loading checks preceded the frozen plan. Each episode had a unique generated model identifier and compiled library; loading records preserve actual solve-symbol dladdr resolution, memory maps, generated C assignments, binary/source hashes, effective OCP and default numerical options. Generated identifiers and output locations are the only construction differences from the default parent. The existing shared simulation lock serialized construction and racing. Control remained50Hz/.02s with unchanged recorded physics/randomization/visibility/gate rules. Wall execution was allowed to slow for capture.
    
    plan.json fixed both selected seeds, default numerics only, two episodes, source/runtime provenance, fresh output paths and full logging before racing. Exactly **976 RTI-QP snapshots** were retained:490 for the first episode and486 for the second. Every RTI solve is retained, so all failures and all preceding successful QPs are available.
    
    Each lossless NPZ contains the full QP Hessian blocks Q/R/S, gradients q/r, dynamics A/B/b, state/input/general bounds and constraint matrices/index maps whenever nonempty, plus current observed state, controller state, all pre-solve warm-start x/u/z/pi/lam/sl/su arrays, every stage’s path-reference parameters, post-solve iterate, tick, seed and RTI pass number. Structurally empty general constraint/slack arrays are absent; this parent has no general C/D rows or soft constraints. Full shared geometry and tick diagnostics, raw and converted commands, QP statistics and timings accompany the snapshots.
    
    Capture occurs immediately after each actual solve and **before controller reset**, including QPs whose solve failed. No residual recomputation, extra factorization or extra diagnostic solve was inserted in a racing episode.

    On every capture, accessible solver iterate arrays x/u/z/pi/lam/sl/su/p and statistics were compared exactly, with NaNs considered equal, before and after QP getters. Two consecutive full-QP reads also matched. All976 checks passed. Parameter arrays remained unchanged through the solve.     ## Offline inspection
    
    The detailed inspection covers all10 failing QPs plus the last five successful QPs before the failure sequence in each episode:20 frozen QPs total. All original976 snapshots remain retained.
    
    - No nonfinite QP matrix, gradient, dynamics or bound entry was found in these20 QPs. No individual lower bound exceeded its corresponding upper bound.
    - Stage Hessians are rank deficient:18/22 at ordinary stages and12/17 at the terminal stage. Minimum observed eigenvalue is-2.75e-14, consistent with numerical roundoff around semidefiniteness; maximum is194.95. Rank deficiency also occurs in successful predecessors, so it is not by itself the discriminating failure explanation.
    - After eliminating initial-state/dynamics equalities, the200-control reduced Hessians are positive definite. Minimum eigenvalues are at least0.04488; largest eigenvalue reaches458.12. Spectral condition numbers range8,909–9,954. Diagonal equilibration reduces them to754–1,098. Coefficient ranges and per-stage spectra/ranks are in inspection.json. Scaling can affect numerical behavior, but it does not remove the observed feasibility conflict.
    - Independent feasibility LPs agree: all10 successful predecessors are feasible; all10 failed QPs are infeasible. One audit builds the full897-variable state/input problem directly; another eliminates the dynamics into a200-control problem.
    
    A direct one-step certificate avoids relying solely on an LP status. For seed1606110700 at tick158/pass1, the smallest achievable next roll delta is0.1726618233 while the QP requires it<=0.0588968563: gap0.1137649670rad. For seed1606110739 at tick155/pass1, minimum next pitch delta0.0160645283 exceeds the required upper delta0.0135134254: gap0.0025511028rad. These deltas are relative to the recorded warm-start state; applying that shift gives an unavoidable violation of the original.875rad future state-angle bound. Admissible inputs cannot close either interval gap.
    
    At those first failures, measured initial pitch is already approximately.921535rad and.889076rad, respectively. Initial state equality is retained, while future states are forced back inside.875rad. The captured linearization and input bounds do not permit that return quickly enough. This distinguishes hard command limits from hard state-angle bounds; the former do not guarantee instantaneous satisfaction of the latter.
    
    As a diagnostic only, the minimum uniform relaxation of future roll/pitch/yaw state bounds needed for feasibility ranges from0.002551 to0.435620rad across failed QPs. The latter is about25 degrees: this is not a negligible constraint adjustment. This computation does not select a flight envelope or authorize changing one.
    
    ## Offline repair experiments
    
    The standalone replay uses the installed acados PARTIAL_CONDENSING_HPIPM interface, horizon40/condensed10, default square-root Riccati, BALANCE profile and cold QP starts. It loads precisely the saved linear QP data with initial-state equalities eliminated. No NLP, controller or physics step is run. Baseline replay reproduces every failure’s inner QP status3 and iteration count. A successful replay’s delta-state agrees with the saved NLP iterate change to about9e-16 in the initial validation. Private QP memory and NLP adaptive tolerances were not transplanted; this limits claims of complete execution-context identity.
    
    Inputs and candidate settings were recorded before offline test execution; NPZ hashes are checked before use. Earlier replay prototypes and logs are preserved. Repeated offline validation passes were used to retain solution vectors and independently check their constraints; none added racing episodes.
    
    | Offline candidate | Failed QPs solved | Successful predecessors solved |
    |---|---:|---:|
    |Unchanged default|0/10|10/10|
    |LM=.001|0/10|10/10|
    |LM=.01|0/10|10/10|
    |LM=.1|0/10|10/10|
    |LM=1|0/10|10/10|
    |Objective scale=.001|0/10|10/10|
    |Objective scale=1000|0/10|10/10|
    |Soft future state angles, Z=1000|10/10|10/10|
    |Soft future state angles, Z=10000|10/10|10/10|
    |Soft future state angles, Z=100000|10/10|10/10|
    
    LM adds the installed acados cost-scaled diagonal term (.02*LM at ordinary stages, LM at terminal) to the frozen Hessian, leaving constraints unchanged. Constant positive objective scaling multiplies Hessians/gradients and preserves the exact feasible set/minimizer, although it changes tolerance scaling. Neither can make an infeasible QP feasible. Every failed original QP still returned NAN_SOL under these tested numerical changes.
    
    The soft cases add independent nonnegative lower/upper slacks only to future roll/pitch/yaw **state** bounds, with quadratic penalties Z in the already time-scaled frozen QP. Initial state equalities, command bounds, progress bounds and dynamics remain hard and unchanged. These are explicit formulation changes, not alternative claimed executions of the original QPs. Penalties1000–100000 produced convergence on all20 snapshots; failures needed up to24 IPM iterations at the largest penalty. Maximum slack remains0.435620rad, because some violations are unavoidable under the hard dynamics/input bounds.
    
    Saved offline x/u/sl/su solutions were independently checked for all60 softened solves. Maximum dynamics residual is below5e-15; no positive hard-bound or soft-constraint violation was found at retained precision. The solver’s residual checks also passed. Positive slack is a permitted relaxation, not satisfaction of the original hard attitude bounds.
    
    ## Decision
    
    No stronger LM or objective-scaling setting is identified as a repair. The evidence supports investigating **soft future attitude-state constraints with an explicit penalty while retaining hard command limits**, because this resolves the captured feasibility conflict offline. It is a plausible formulation hypothesis, not a racing-performance, stability or safety result. Offline tests do not identify a preferred penalty or establish that the resulting controller will finish more races or run faster.
    
    The next separately authorized step should implement and verify a bounded research soft-state-constraint adapter, preserving the exact parent comparator, before a fresh matched racing screen. Freeze its penalty/envelope and analysis in advance; only promising fresh results would justify larger fresh confirmation. No such implementation/racing batch or prediction/adaptation screen is launched here.
